# Try DOWN on P-symbol 0 to see if it changes
cur_ascii = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

def get_p_symbol(ascii_lines, si):
    inner_col = 15 + si * 7
    return tuple(ascii_lines[51+dr][inner_col:inner_col+5] for dr in range(1, 6))

state_before = get_p_symbol(cur_ascii, 0)
print(f"P-symbol 0 before DOWN: {state_before}")

action(['DOWN'])
cur_ascii2 = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
state_after = get_p_symbol(cur_ascii2, 0)
print(f"P-symbol 0 after DOWN: {state_after}")
print(f"Changed: {state_before != state_after}")

# If DOWN also doesn't change it, try cycling through all symbols to find which ones are editable
print("\nChecking all P symbols for editability:")
for si in range(5):
    # Move cursor to symbol si
    # Current cursor is at P-symbol 0
    if si > 0:
        action(['RIGHT'] * si)
    cur_ascii3 = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    state0 = get_p_symbol(cur_ascii3, si)
    
    # Try UP
    action(['UP'])
    cur_ascii4 = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    state1 = get_p_symbol(cur_ascii4, si)
    
    if state0 != state1:
        print(f"  P-symbol {si}: UP changes it")
    else:
        # Try DOWN
        action(['DOWN'])
        cur_ascii5 = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
        state2 = get_p_symbol(cur_ascii5, si)
        if state0 != state2:
            print(f"  P-symbol {si}: DOWN changes it")
        else:
            print(f"  P-symbol {si}: neither UP nor DOWN changes it")
    
    # Move back to symbol 0
    if si > 0:
        action(['LEFT'] * si)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
